div.div: the model's own taste, on real products
products that exist; nothing says they go together

div.span: the brand's looks, then the catalog

div.div: the looks each suggestion comes from, with counts
The same question, the same answer model, the same catalog
Only the evidence differs: none, products the model searched for, or the looks the brand wears.

div.span: A photo instead of a question

div.div: the garment you want to wear
text and images share one vector space
the same catalog search and prompt
RAG's planner looks at the photo and plans its catalog searches from what it sees. LLM only describes it.
